agentTypeName.description:
The name of the non-abstract {@link GenaiCore.Agent} type that will be instantiated from
this {@link GenaiCore.Agent.Template} or {@link GenaiCore.Agent.Draft}.

agentFieldValues.description:
The field values of the {@link GenaiCore.Agent} that will be instantiated from this
{@link GenaiCore.Agent.Template} or {@link GenaiCore.Agent.Draft}.
The key of the map represents the field name and the value represents the field value.

title:
Holds the common fields and APIs that are used on {@link GenaiCore.Agent.Template} and {@link GenaiCore.Agent.Draft} to
represent an incomplete {@link GenaiCore.Agent} entity.
name: GenaiCore.Agent.Reference
